name: VX-L350 Wheel Loader
blurb: Our largest production loader. Five-cubic-metre class buckets, locking differentials and a load-sensing hydraulic circuit built for quarry duty.
features: Load-sensing hydraulics with automatic bucket levelling
Locking front and rear differentials as standard
Reversible cooling fan for dust-heavy sites
Onboard weighing with ticket printing
overview: The VX-L350 is the machine we sell to quarries and bulk-handling yards that load all day and stop only to refuel. The powertrain is matched to a 6.2 to 12.7 cubic metre bucket range, so the same chassis handles blasted rock and light aggregate without a driveline change. Every unit leaves our workshop with a full pre-delivery inspection, a torque-checked driveline and a twelve-month powertrain warranty.

name: VX-L260 Wheel Loader
blurb: A mid-weight loader for concrete plants and recycling yards, with high lift geometry and a quick-coupler carriage.
features: High-lift boom option for tipping into 4 m walled bays
Hydraulic quick coupler with fork and grapple carriage
Wet multi-disc brakes with independent circuits
Rear-view camera and reversing radar
overview: Built for the yards that run two shifts and rehandle the same stockpile all week. High-lift geometry clears the tallest tipper bodies on a standard chassis, and the quick coupler takes forks, grapples and light material buckets without a workshop visit.

name: VX-L220 Wheel Loader
blurb: A 4,100-hour certified used loader, fully inspected, with a new set of cutting edges and a fresh hydraulic service.
features: 140-point certified used inspection with written report
New cutting edges and rebuilt bucket pins
Full hydraulic and driveline oil change on handover
Six-month drivetrain warranty included
overview: Certified used means the machine went through the same workshop process as a trade-in we would keep for our own rental fleet: a 140-point inspection, oil sampling on every circuit, and a written report you get before you pay a deposit. Anything outside tolerance is repaired, not discounted.

name: VX-H200 High Lift Loader
blurb: Log and timber handling specification, with a rotating grapple, guarded cab and extended lift height.
features: 360-degree rotating timber grapple
Full cab guarding to forestry specification
Extended lift arms for high-sided trailers
Heavy counterweight and axle guarding
overview: A handling specification rather than a loading one. The extended arms and rotating grapple let one machine load a high-sided trailer from either side without repositioning, which is the difference between two loads an hour and four.

name: VX-E480 Crawler Excavator
blurb: A 48-tonne mass excavation machine with a reinforced undercarriage and dual auxiliary hydraulic circuits.
features: Twin auxiliary circuits for breaker and shear
Heavy-duty undercarriage with full-length track guards
Boom and arm float with automatic idle
Machine-control ready with factory mounting points
overview: Sized for mass excavation and demolition rather than trenching. The dual auxiliary circuits mean a breaker and a shear can stay plumbed at the same time, so an attachment change is a pin change rather than a hose change.

name: VX-E220 Crawler Excavator
blurb: The site workhorse. Twenty-two tonnes, 6,800 hours, tilt-rotate ready and sold with a fresh undercarriage.
features: New tracks, idlers and sprockets fitted before sale
Tilt-rotate hydraulics already piped
Three buckets and a grading beam included
Certified used inspection report supplied
overview: Twenty-two tonnes is the size most groundworks contractors buy first and keep longest. This one comes out of a single-owner fleet on a full service history, with the undercarriage replaced rather than measured and passed.

name: VX-D90 Crawler Dozer
blurb: A semi-U blade dozer for bulk push and haul-road maintenance, with factory-fitted grade control.
features: Semi-U blade with hydraulic tilt and pitch
2D grade control fitted and calibrated
Sealed and lubricated track chain
Rear ripper with three shanks
overview: Bulk earthmoving and haul-road upkeep on one machine. Grade control is fitted and calibrated in our workshop, not sold as a later upgrade, so the first pass on site is already on design level.

name: VX-A45 Articulated Hauler
blurb: A 45-tonne payload six-wheel-drive hauler for soft ground, with retarder braking and a heated body.
features: Permanent six-wheel drive with inter-axle locks
Exhaust-heated body for sticky material
Hydraulic retarder for long downhill hauls
Onboard payload weighing with shift reporting
overview: The hauler we recommend when the haul road is soft, steep or both. Permanent six-wheel drive keeps it moving in wet clay, and the retarder takes the load off the service brakes on a long descent.

name: VX-G160 Motor Grader
blurb: A 4.3-metre mouldboard grader for haul roads, sub-base trimming and snow work.
features: All-wheel drive with hydraulic front-wheel assist
3D machine-control mounts and harness fitted
Front lift group and rear ripper
Joystick steering with variable ratio
overview: Trimming to design level on a grader is a skill, and machine control shortens the learning curve. We supply the mounts, harness and calibration with the machine so the mast goes on the blade the day it lands.

name: VX-B120 Backhoe Loader
blurb: Two machines in one for utilities work: a four-in-one loader shovel at the front and a sideshift backhoe behind.
features: Four-in-one front shovel with pallet forks
Sideshift backhoe for working against a kerb
Extending dipper arm as standard
40 km/h road speed with trailer braking
overview: For utility gangs who need to dig, load, backfill and then drive to the next street without a low-loader. The sideshift carriage matters more than the numbers: it is what lets you dig tight against a kerb line.

name: VX-R140 Soil Compactor
blurb: A padfoot soil roller with 2,300 hours, compaction metering and a fresh drum bearing set.
features: Padfoot drum with bolt-on smooth shell kit
Compaction meter with pass counting
New drum bearings and isolation mounts
ROPS cab with air conditioning
overview: Compaction is the cheapest part of an earthworks package to get wrong. Pass counting tells the operator when the layer is done, which stops both the under-rolled layer and the six wasted passes after it.

name: VX-T70 Telehandler
blurb: A seven-tonne, 17-metre telehandler with stabilisers, load charts on screen and a hydraulic attachment lock.
features: Hydraulic stabilisers with automatic levelling
On-screen load chart tied to the fitted attachment
Hydraulic attachment lock, no dismount to change
Three steering modes including crab
overview: The machine that keeps a build moving between the crane hires. Seventeen metres reaches the fourth lift of scaffold, and the on-screen load chart changes with the attachment rather than living in a laminated card in the door pocket.
